app.name: Shelf Pulse
app.tagline: Spot ageing stock early. Route it before it becomes waste.

footer.disclaimer: Concept prototype for the L'Oréal Sustainability Challenge 2026. Not an official L'Oréal product. Example data.

welcome.repDesc: Today's beat, shelf check and actions in the shop
welcome.managerDesc: Approve flags, track waste, growth and sustainability

status.greenHint: Healthy. Fix anything in this visit.
status.amberHint: Slow. Act now while there is time.
status.redHint: Near act-by. Choose a route within 48 hours.

sync.title: Sync
sync.savedLocally: Your work is saved on this phone, even without network.
sync.resetConfirm: Reset all demo data? Today's counts and decisions will be cleared.

rep.todayIntro: Your beat, ranked by what needs attention first.

manager.title: Area manager desk
manager.intro: Flags to decide, territory health and waste avoided.

common.buildingNext: This screen arrives in the next build step.

brief.title: Before you go in
brief.nudgeOverdue_one: {{count}} batch is past its act-by date
brief.nudgeOverdue_other: {{count}} batches are past their act-by date
brief.launchWhy: Lip products sell here every visit

line.recount: This is more than last count plus deliveries. Please recount.

signal.same_batch_no_sales: Same batch as last visit, no sales (auto)

count.title: Shelf check
count.photoDone: Counts filled from the photo. Check each one.

talk.title: Three quick questions
talk.q1: Did customers ask for something you don't stock?
talk.q2: Has anyone asked for a discount on these?
talk.q3: Any unopened cartons in the backroom?

actions.title: Actions
actions.allGreen: Nothing slow or near expiry here. Keep facings full.
actions.settlement: Settled through the distributor: credit note to this shop, invoice to the receiver. Your payout is released when it sells there.
actions.noIncentive: No transfer incentive: sold in here within 8 weeks.
actions.greenCredit: Flagging now earns the retailer a swap into fast sellers.

owner.area_manager_and_regional_head: Area manager and regional head choose a route within 48 hours

step.move: Move it to a shop where it sells

why.transfer: {{outlet}} sells this every visit and has a delivery run on {{date}}.
why.salon_backbar: Professional product with {{n}} days left: a partner salon can use it in services.
why.b2b_buyer: Sealed with {{n}} days left: an approved buyer recovers cash.
why.staff_sale: {{n}} days left: a staff sale uses it before expiry.
why.donation: Sealed and in date: a vetted NGO can use it, marked not for sale.
why.tester: Outer pack damaged, product intact: use it as a tester.
why.epr_recycling: Too close to expiry to use: recycle the packaging through EPR.
why.fix_visibility: Hard to see: bring it to eye level, label facing out.
why.shopkeeper_brief: Tell the shopkeeper in 30 seconds who it is for.
why.bundle_hero: Keep it next to {{hero}} as a bundle (sealed packs only).
why.trial_minis: Offer sachets or minis so customers can try it.
why.move: Tried on 2 visits without moving. {{outlet}} sells it every visit.
why.moveNoReceiver: Tried on 2 visits. No matching shop has a delivery run yet.

reason.fast_topup: Fast seller: topped up to 2 visits

share.title: For the retailer
share.intro: Show this card or send the message yourself. Nothing is sent automatically.
share.creditBody: Slow stock flagged early is swapped into fast sellers. Late returns at expiry get the standard settlement.

msg.bundle: Idea for the shelf: keep {{slow}} next to {{hero}} as a bundle.
msg.swap: If any stock is slow, tell me early and we will swap it into fast sellers.

godown.title: Godown check
godown.intro: Weekly check at {{distributor}}: oldest batches first.
godown.fastest: Send to the fastest shops first: {{outlets}}
godown.tooShort: Less than the 60 days shops need on arrival: route through the recovery ladder.

ai.title: AI help
ai.intro: AI only suggests. You confirm every count, signal and message.
ai.mode_off: Off: rules and manual entry only
ai.liveMissing: No server key found. Live mode will fall back to the offline version.

voice.title: Voice note
voice.intro: Say what you see, in any language. The app suggests signals; you apply them.
voice.demoNote: Demo mode uses a sample note instead of the microphone.
voice.none: Nothing found. Add signals by hand below.
voice.sample: The sunscreen has two unopened cartons in the backroom. Customers asked for a discount on the lipstick. People keep asking for kajal.

mgr.pilotNote: Example data. Thresholds are a pilot proposal.

kpi.atRiskSub: Amber and red lines, at shelf value
kpi.loadingGood: Below zero: shoppers are buying faster than we ship
kpi.loadingWarn: Above zero: shipping faster than shoppers buy
kpi.trendTitle: Return and expiry rate, last 8 weeks

flags.title: Flags to decide
flags.intro: Red first, then the nearest deadline. Each flag shows what the rep saw.
flags.categoryBody: {{sku}} is red in {{n}} outlets. Take it to the monthly demand review.

impact.title: Impact
impact.intro: Outcomes, not flag counts. Every unit routed up the waste hierarchy instead of to destruction.
impact.co2: CO₂ is not shown: no emission factors have been provided.
impact.packagingNote: Packaging uses each product's pack weight (pilot proposal).
impact.repLine: {{rep}}: {{saved}} saved from waste · {{n}} batches resolved before act-by

summary.resolved: {{n}} of {{due}} flags were resolved before their act-by date.
summary.saved: {{saved}} kept from waste so far, and {{units}} units kept from destruction.
summary.rate: Return and expiry rate is {{rate}}, against {{control}} in the control territory.
summary.osa: Must-sell availability is {{osa}}, so growth is protected.
summary.open_one: {{count}} flag is waiting for your decision.
summary.open_other: {{count}} flags are waiting for your decision.
summary.category: {{sku}} is red in {{n}} outlets: take it to the monthly demand review.
